lines.en: label undeservedfuture7:
scene clearnightsky
So we head outside and hop into the first of many taxis positioned in a queue parallel to the valet parking lane which is, for some reason, still operating this late at night.
lines.zh: 于是我们走到外面，上了排成一列、与代客泊车道并行的众多出租车中的第一辆——不知为何，那条车道这么晚了还在运营。

lines.en: {size=-2}And still rather busy too. It seems like Sana chose a popular spot — which is one more aspect of her person that seems all the more different from the girl I remember in school, who could barely even look at me at first.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}而且还挺忙的。看来 Sana 挑了个热门地方——这又是她身上与我记忆中那个上学时的女孩大不相同的一点，那个女孩一开始连看都不敢看我。{/size}

lines.en: There’s a lot that’s different now, though. Even the people that line the streets have gone back to a more reasonable split of sexes now that those like me have descended.
lines.zh: 不过现在不一样的地方有很多。连街上的行人，也因为像我这样的人降临，而回到了更合理的性别比例。

lines.en: And while I kind of wish that wasn’t the case, it’s for reasons you might not have expected this time.
lines.zh: 虽然我有点希望事情不是这样，但这次的理由可能是你没料到的。

lines.en: Reasons that, conceptually, still revolve around jealousy and angst, but combine to make me seem like a good person rather than a bad one.
lines.zh: 那些理由在概念上依然绕着嫉妒和焦虑打转，但合在一起，却让我看起来像个好人，而不是坏人。

lines.en: {i}Am{/i} I good now, though? That’s the question I’ve been asking myself a lot these days.
lines.zh: 可我{i}现在{/i}是好人了吗？这是我最近一直在问自己的问题。

lines.en: Temptation isn’t so tempting anymore. I am present. And I am entirely dedicated to cultivating my own personal garden rather than propagating every plant I find out in the wild.
lines.zh: 诱惑没那么诱人了。我活在当下。我全心全意地耕耘自己的花园，而不是在野外见到什么植物就到处播种。

lines.en: It’s working, too. We don’t argue. We don’t fight. We just exist in the same place, eat at the same table, and sleep within the confines of the same home.
lines.zh: 而且这招很管用。我们不吵。我们不闹。我们只是在同一个地方存在，在同一张桌子吃饭，在同一个家的四壁之内入睡。

lines.en: If I was a religious man like my mother wished, I’d go so far as saying this might be Heaven.
lines.zh: 如果我像我母亲期望的那样是个有信仰的人，我甚至会说这里或许就是天堂。

lines.en: Look — I capitalized the H and everything. I’m not overflowing with scorn or spite any longer. I’m ready to learn and willing to work.
lines.zh: 看啊——我连 H 都特意大写了。我不再满溢着轻蔑和怨毒。我准备好学习了，也愿意付出努力。

lines.en: The main reason I {i}don’t{/i} call it Heaven, though, is because I’ve accepted this as reality.
lines.zh: {i}不{/i}过我没把它叫做天堂的最主要原因是，我已经接受了这就是现实。

lines.en: I {i}have{/i} reached the good ending. And I’ve reset in a way that, not so dissimilar from how it was when I {i}woke up{/i} in Kumon-mi, has granted me a {i}third{/i} chance at life.
lines.zh: 我{i}抵达{/i}了好结局。而我以某种方式重置了自己——和当初在 Kumon-mi {i}醒来{/i}时没什么两样——这给了我{i}第三次{/i}人生。

lines.en: And I will not make the same mistakes again — for I understand what it is I have to protect now.
lines.zh: 而我不会再犯同样的错误——因为我现在明白自己要守护的是什么了。

lines.en: scene black
And as I twist the key into the lock of my door once more, I find myself forcing {i}back{/i} a smile rather than trying to remember how to don one for once.
lines.zh: 当我再次转动钥匙插进家门的锁孔，我发现自己是在把笑意{i}憋回去{/i}，而不是像从前那样，努力回忆该怎么挂上一个笑容。

lines.en: Maybe {i}that’s{/i} why I still look so young despite the passage of time? More...{i}facial exercise{/i} or something like that?
lines.zh: 也许这{i}就是{/i}岁月流逝，我看起来却依然这么年轻的原因？算是……更多的{i}面部运动{/i}什么的？

lines.en: Whatever the case, it’s not like any of this actually matters since {i}your{/i} days are numbered now too — just as mine are.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，这些其实都不重要了——因为{i}你的{/i}日子现在也进入倒计时了，就像我的一样。

lines.en: You have no reason or desire to watch someone who isn’t struggling, do you?
lines.zh: 你没有理由、也没有欲望去看一个并不挣扎的人，对吧？

lines.en: I don’t blame you for that. Joy doesn’t hit the same way sorrow does — and I likely wouldn’t watch my own life right now either.
lines.zh: 我不怪你。喜悦带来的冲击和悲伤不一样——换作是我，大概也不会想看自己的人生现在的样子。

lines.en: But that might just be because I’m too busy actually {i}living{/i} it.
lines.zh: 不过那也许只是因为，我正忙着真正地{i}过{/i}它。

lines.en: : Hima-chan! We’re home!
lines.zh: : Hima 酱！我们回来了！

lines.en: scene himadinner1
And that every second I spend watching something else would do naught but distract me from the first face I’ve ever known that makes all the misery in the world just melt away.
lines.zh: 而我花在注视别的东西上的每一秒，都只会让我分心——分掉那张我此生所知的、能让世间一切苦难都融化的脸。

lines.en: I really am a loser now, aren’t I?
lines.zh: 我现在真是个废物了，对吧？

lines.en: : Sorry we’re late! We lost track of time with Sana and-
lines.zh: : 抱歉我们回来晚了！跟 Sana 聊得忘了时间，而且——

lines.en: : Something feels off.
lines.zh: : 感觉有点不对劲。

lines.en: scene himadinner2
: Off? How do you mean?
lines.zh: : 不对劲？什么意思？

lines.en: : She normally greets us at the door.
lines.zh: : 她平时都会在门口迎接我们的。

lines.en: : Akira, it’s like midnight. She’s probably just asleep.
lines.zh: : Akira，都快午夜了。她大概只是睡着了。

lines.en: : No...Something’s different. I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 不……有什么不一样了。我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: scene himadinner3
: Hima-chan! Are you awake?! Your father is having daughter withdrawal again and it’s making him be all negative on our anniversary!
lines.zh: : Hima 酱！你醒着吗？！你爸爸的女儿戒断反应又犯了，害他在我们的纪念日上全程负能量！

lines.en: scene himadinner4
: Okay...yeah. Something {i}does{/i} feel different. I get what you mean now.
lines.zh: : 好吧……是啊。{i}确实{/i}有什么不一样了。我现在懂你的意思了。

lines.en: : She’d have told us if she went to a friend’s house, right?
lines.zh: : 她要是去了朋友家，会跟我们说一声的对吧？

lines.en: : I’ll check her room. Maybe she just has her headphones on again or something?
lines.zh: : 我去看看她的房间。也许她只是又戴上耳机了什么的？

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll come with you.
lines.zh: : 我跟你一起去。

lines.en: : Akira, are we overbearing as parents? Do we dote on our daughter too much? Would a {i}normal{/i} couple be this anxious like five seconds after walking into their own home?
lines.zh: : Akira，我们作为父母是不是太操心了？我们是不是太宠女儿了？{i}正常{/i}夫妻踏进自己家门五秒钟就会这么焦虑吗？

lines.en: : If something feels off, probably.
lines.zh: : 如果感觉不对劲，大概会吧。

lines.en: : Himawari, open up. We’re back from-
lines.zh: : Himawari，开门。我们回来了——

lines.en: : Wait! Akira, look...
lines.zh: : 等等！Akira，你看……

lines.en: : What? What are you-
lines.zh: : 什么？你在——

lines.en: Ayane grabs me by the wrist and pulls me away from the door.
lines.zh: Ayane 一把抓住我的手腕，把我从门口拉开。

lines.en: Past the bathroom.
lines.zh: 经过浴室。

lines.en: Down the hall.
lines.zh: 沿着走廊。

lines.en: Into the living room.
lines.zh: 进了客厅。

lines.en: And what we find is-
lines.zh: 而我们看到的是——

lines.en: scene himadinner5
What we find is {i}this.{/i}
lines.zh: 我们看到的是{i}这样{/i}。

lines.en: : Wha...
: Did Hima-chan do all of this?...
lines.zh: : 这些都是 Hima 酱做的？……

lines.en: scene himadinner6
: Did {i}you{/i} put her up to it? Is this some sort of coordinated father-daughter surprise to try and make me love you more? Your acting’s gotten really good, Akira.
lines.zh: : 是你指使她的吗？这是不是{i}你们{/i}父女串通好的惊喜，想让我更爱你？你的演技进步很大啊，Akira。

lines.en: : I have nothing to do with this. I’m just as surprised as you.
lines.zh: : 这跟我没关系。我跟你一样惊讶。

lines.en: : I’m currently too relieved to feel any happiness, though. So get back to me in a few minutes and ask me how I feel about it then.
lines.zh: : 不过我现在松了口气，还没来得及感到开心。你过几分钟再来问我感受如何吧。

lines.en: scene himadinner7
: There’s a note too. Look.
lines.zh: : 还有一张纸条。你看。

lines.en: scene himadinner8
: Happy anniversary...Your server will be with you shortly...
lines.zh: : 周年快乐……您的服务员马上就到……

lines.en: : Does she not know we literally {i}just{/i} went out to eat?
lines.zh: : 她不知道我们{i}刚刚{/i}才出去吃过饭吗？

lines.en: scene himadinner9
: Oh no. I’m going to cry.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我要哭了。

lines.en: : Please don’t. That’ll make {i}me{/i} want to cry and I’ve done such a good job my whole life at avoiding that.
lines.zh: : 别哭。那样{i}我{/i}也会想哭，而我这辈子一直很努力地避免这件事。

lines.en: scene himadinner10
: Nope! Here it comes! She’s too pure for this world, Akira! What did we do to deserve a daughter like her?!
lines.zh: : 不行！眼泪来了！她对这个世界来说太纯洁了，Akira！我们到底做了什么，才配得上这样的女儿？！

lines.en: : Mr. and Mrs. Arakawa — welcome to Chateau de L’Himawari. We’d like to extend our gratitude for you dining with us on such a special occasion.
lines.zh: : Arakawa 先生、Arakawa 太太——欢迎光临「Himawari 城堡」。非常感谢二位在这样一个特别的日子选择在我们这里用餐。

lines.en: scene himadinner11
: And now she’s in a {i}tuxedo?!{/i} Akira, look! Hima-chan’s wearing a tuxedo! She’s so cute that I want to blow the house up! This is the greatest day of my life!
lines.zh: : 而且她还穿了{i}礼服{/i}？！Akira，你看！Hima 酱穿着礼服！她可爱到让我想把这栋房子炸了！这是我这辈子最棒的一天！

lines.en: : I’m flattered, Mom. Really. But you might want to keep your voice down or you’re going to wake the entire neighborhood up.
lines.zh: : 您过奖了，妈妈。真的。不过您最好小声点，不然整条街都要被您吵醒了。

lines.en: : {b}{size=+10}LET THEM WAKE UP! I DON’T CARE!{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+10}让他们醒！我不在乎！{/size}{/b}

lines.en: : Himawari...if we’d known you were going to do this, we wouldn’t have stayed out so late. You should’ve said something.
lines.zh: : Himawari……如果我们知道你要做这些，就不会在外面待那么晚了。你该跟我们说一声的。

lines.en: scene himadinner12
: And ruined the surprise? As if! I don’t mind staying up a little later than normal if it means getting to do something special for you two.
lines.zh: : 然后毁了惊喜？想得美！只要能为你们俩做点特别的事，我晚睡一会儿也无所谓。

lines.en: : A fancy dinner’s the least I can do to say thanks to you guys for literally creating me.
lines.zh: : 毕竟你们是字面意义上地创造了出来了我，一顿像样的晚餐是我至少能做的感谢。

lines.en: scene himadinner13
: Oh, and Aunt Sana helped too. Getting you guys out of the house long enough for me to set everything up would have been impossible without her.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有 Sana 阿姨也帮忙了。没有她，我不可能把你们支开这么久，好把这一切布置好。

lines.en: : Plus, I’m not old enough to buy alcohol yet and I needed an adult for that since Dad doesn’t want me using my gun to intimidate shopkeepers.
lines.zh: : 再说，我还不到能买酒的年纪，所以需要一个大人——因为爸爸不许我拿枪去吓唬店员。

lines.en: : That goes against family tradition, though! It’s why I bought you a gun in the first place!
lines.zh: : 可那违背了家族传统啊！我当初给你买枪就是为了这个！

lines.en: scene himadinner14
: Right? Like, maybe it’s just a girl thing because he clearly doesn’t get it.
lines.zh: : 对吧？大概这就是女孩子才懂的事，因为他明显不理解。

lines.en: : Yeah, silly me for not wanting my daughter flashing a firearm in public. Either way, you didn’t have to-
lines.zh: : 是啊，我真傻，居然不想让女儿在公共场合亮枪。总之，你其实不必——

lines.en: scene himadinner15
: Just scold me tomorrow if you have to! You only get one anniversary each year and it’s {i}my{/i} job to make sure it’s a good one since {i}you{/i} never remember the date!
lines.zh: : 要骂就明天再骂！一年只有一次纪念日，而{i}你{/i}们从来记不住日期，所以让它圆满就是{i}我的{/i}工作！

lines.en: scene himadinner16
: Now, with that out of the way, might I recommend this 1975 Chateau Margaux?
lines.zh: : 那么，闲话少说，我可以推荐这瓶 1975 年的 Chateau Margaux 吗？

lines.en: : Its mature and savory flavor profile with hints of tobacco, cloves, and bitter cherries give it a remarkable tannic firmness that makes it an exquisite pairing for both venison and wild game.
lines.zh: : 它成熟而醇厚的风味中带着烟草、丁香和苦樱桃的气息，单宁结构格外坚实，与鹿肉和野味搭配堪称绝妙。

lines.en: : I will drink anything you put in front of me.
lines.zh: : 你摆在我面前什么我就喝什么。

lines.en: : So you’re a sommelier now? Giving up on piano already?
lines.zh: : 那你现在是侍酒师了？钢琴这么快就放弃了？

lines.en: scene himadinner17
: Not at all. It’s just easier to memorize pretentious wine descriptions off the Internet than it is to figure out VII. Cadenza I from Sorabji's “Opus Clavicembalisticum.”
lines.zh: : 完全没有。比起搞懂 Sorabji《Opus Clavicembalisticum》里的第七段华彩，从网上背点装腔作势的葡萄酒描述要容易多了。

lines.en: : {size=-1}I’m proud you even figured out the pronunciation of whatever it is you just said. But even {i}more{/i} proud of your father for managing to keep your brain from deteriorating as your new teacher.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}你能把刚才那串东西念出来，我就已经很骄傲了。不过我更骄傲的是你爸爸——作为你的新老师，他居然没让你的脑子退化。{/size}

lines.en: scene himadinner18
: Dad’s a great teacher! I’ve literally never been happier. Plus, being a server-slash-sommelier is way more fun when I don’t have to worry about doing homework in between courses.
lines.zh: : 爸爸是很棒的老师！我真的从来没这么开心过。再说，不用在两道菜之间赶作业，当服务员兼侍酒师有趣多了。

lines.en: : There are {i}courses?{/i}
lines.zh: : 还有{i}好几道菜{/i}？

lines.en: scene himadinner19
: {i}Two{/i} of them, to be precise. Wine and then dinner.
lines.zh: : 准确地说，{i}两道{/i}。先是酒，然后是晚餐。

lines.en: : You’re counting “wine” as a course?
lines.zh: : 你把「酒」也算成一道菜？

lines.en: : I’m about to count “whine” as a third one if you don’t stop your complaining already.
lines.zh: : 你要是再抱怨，我就要把「牢骚」也算成第三道菜了。

lines.en: : What’s on the menu, Hima-chan? Assuming this isn’t a pre-prepared tasting menu of exactly one item.
lines.zh: : 菜单上有什么，Hima 酱？假设这不是那种只有一样东西、提前准备好的试吃菜单。

lines.en: scene himadinner20
: Tonight’s specials are as follows: brown-sugar glazed salmon with a Mediterranean vegetable medley, frozen garlic bread, and A-5 wagyu hamburg steak served with a red wine reduction.
lines.zh: : 今晚的特别菜单如下：红糖釉烤三文鱼配地中海什锦蔬菜、冷冻蒜香面包，以及 A5 和牛汉堡排配红酒酱汁。

lines.en: : I feel like one of those things could have been left off the menu.
lines.zh: : 我觉得其中一样本来可以不出现在菜单上的。

lines.en: scene himadinner21
: Yeah, that wagyu really ate up most of the budget. Should’ve just gone with more garlic bread.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那份和牛吃掉了我大部分预算。早知道多买点蒜香面包了。

lines.en: : I’ll have the salmon, Hima-chan. I’m sorry in advance if I can’t finish it, though. And also if I am drunk after one more glass of wine. We stayed at the hotel bar longer than I expected.
lines.zh: : 我要三文鱼，Hima 酱。不过先说抱歉，我可能吃不完。还有，如果再喝一杯就醉了，也先说抱歉。我们在酒店酒吧待得比预想的久。

lines.en: scene himadinner22
: No worries at all. Your orders have been taken and I will begin preparing them immediately.
lines.zh: : 完全没关系。二位的点单已经收到，我马上去准备。

lines.en: : But I haven’t even ordered yet.
lines.zh: : 可我还没点呢。

lines.en: scene himadinner23
: The menu is more of a formality than anything. I know you want the hamburg steak and I knew Mom would want the salmon. I merely gave you the illusion of choice.
lines.zh: : 菜单什么的只是走个形式。我知道你要汉堡排，也知道妈妈会要三文鱼。我只是给了你一种选择的幻觉。

lines.en: : Do you need help with anything? I’m obviously not a great cook, but I can at least-
lines.zh: : 需要我帮忙吗？我显然不是什么好厨子，但至少我能——

lines.en: : Dad — you’re not seriously planning on trying to {i}help{/i} me do something nice for you guys, are you? I can cook. I don’t need you to chip in here.
lines.zh: : 爸爸——你不会真打算{i}帮{/i}我为你们俩做点好事吧？我会做饭。这里不需要你插手。

lines.en: : It just seems like a lot for-
lines.zh: : 只是看起来工作量挺大的——

lines.en: : I am {i}fine.{/i} Just relax and drink with Mom while I get started. Do yourself a favor and forget I’m even here.
lines.zh: : 我{i}没事{/i}的。你放松点，跟妈妈喝酒就好，我去开始了。帮自己个忙，就当我不在这儿。

lines.en: : Easier said than done, Hima-chan. I’m second place in my own husband’s life now. Which really doesn’t hurt as much as I thought it would given that first place is obviously you.
lines.zh: : 说得容易，Hima 酱。我现在在我自己丈夫心里排第二了。不过既然第一名显然是你，这其实没我想的那么伤人。

lines.en: scene himadinner24
: Well, that’s no good. You’ve gotta call it a tie at least, Dad. You can’t just let your daughter bias beat out your lifelong love for an amazing, beautiful woman.
lines.zh: : 那可不行。至少得算平手吧，爸爸。你不能让「女儿滤镜」压过你对一个又棒又美的女人的终生之爱。

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} a tie.
lines.zh: : {i}就是{/i}平手。

lines.en: : Then why am {i}I{/i} not your wallpaper, hmm?
lines.zh: : 那为什么{i}我{/i}的照片不是你的手机壁纸，嗯？

lines.en: : I’m your wallpaper, Dad? Creepy.
lines.zh: : 我是你的壁纸吗，爸爸？好恶心。

lines.en: : You should have seen what it was in high school.
lines.zh: : 你是没见过高中时候的壁纸。

lines.en: : You should have seen when your mom made an exact replica of my phone, contacts and all, and kept it with her in the event that I lost mine.
lines.zh: : 你是没见过你妈照着我的手机做了个一模一样的复制品，连通讯录都一并复制，随身带着，以防我把手机弄丢。

lines.en: scene himadinner25
: Okay, now that’s {i}actually{/i} creepy. Not just the teasing kind where I make fun of Dad for loving me so much.
lines.zh: : 好了，这个是{i}真的{/i}恶心。不是那种我取笑爸爸太爱我的玩笑式恶心。

lines.en: : We all do creepy things in the name of love, Hima-chan. I also took pictures of him while he was sleeping, framed them, and hung them above my bed.
lines.zh: : 以爱之名，谁都会做点恶心的事，Hima 酱。我还趁他睡着的时候拍了照片，装裱起来挂在床头上呢。

lines.en: : Who {i}are{/i} you all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 你{i}怎么{/i}突然变成这样了？

lines.en: : It’s not “all of a sudden.” This is who I’ve always been. Look — I have sleeping photos of you too.
lines.zh: : 才不是「突然」。我一直都是这样的人。看——我也有你的睡颜照。

lines.en: scene himadinner26
: What the- don’t show me those! You’re making even {i}Dad{/i} look normal right now!
lines.zh: : 什么鬼——别给我看那些！你这么一比，连{i}爸爸{/i}都显得正常了！

lines.en: scene himadinner27

: Just...drink your wine! And ignore the fact that I’m going to be in and out of this kitchen over the next ten to fifteen minutes while I grab stuff out of the fridge to prepare your food in my room.
lines.zh: : 你……你喝你的酒就好！别管我接下来的十到十五分钟会进进出出这间厨房，从冰箱里拿东西回我房间做你们的饭。

lines.en: : Your room? Why are you cooking in your room? Just use the kitchen.
lines.zh: : 你房间？你为什么在自己房间里做饭？用厨房就好啊。

lines.en: : And interrupt your private anniversary dinner where you talk about weird adult stuff with each other? Nooooooo thank you! I’ll be over here — remaining pure.
lines.zh: : 然后打断你们私密的周年晚餐，害你们没法聊那些奇怪的大人话题？谢——谢——我——不——要！我就待在这儿——保持纯洁。

lines.en: : Is that what you think we talk about while you’re not around?
lines.zh: : 你以为你不在的时候我们聊的就是这些？

lines.en: : I try not to think about that at all actually. Now, ignore me! I’m no longer here!
lines.zh: : 其实我尽量不去想这件事。好了，无视我吧！我已经不在这儿了！

lines.en: scene himadinner28
Himawari, with her arms full of ingredients, swings her door shut with her foot and leaves Ayane and me in the living room to try and wrap our heads around how lucky we are to have her.
lines.zh: Himawari 抱着满满一怀食材，用脚把门甩上，把 Ayane 和我留在客厅里，好让我们好好消化一下：拥有她，我们到底有多幸运。

lines.en: {i}And{/i} Sana apparently. Who, ignoring the fact that she may have propositioned me to have an affair with her earlier, helped make this dream a reality as well.
lines.zh: 显然{i}还有{/i} Sana。姑且不论她之前可能怂恿我跟她出轨这件事，她也帮忙让这场梦变成了现实。

lines.en: To think we’d ever end up {i}here,{/i} though — so shamelessly happy despite the scars and the trauma and all that we’ve lost...
lines.zh: 想想我们竟然会走到{i}今天{/i}——带着那些伤疤、那些创伤，还有我们失去的一切，却还能这样不知羞耻地幸福……

lines.en: Well, to think that we’d be anywhere {i}close{/i} to here just makes all of the pain worth it.
lines.zh: 嗯，光是想到我们能走到离这里哪怕{i}近{/i}一点的地方，所有的痛苦就都值了。

lines.en: scene himadinner29
scene himadinner30
It’s {i}definitely{/i} worth it...
lines.zh: 这{i}绝对{/i}是值得的……

lines.en: {i}This{/i} is the future I was meant to end up with.
lines.zh: {i}这{/i}才是我本该抵达的未来。

lines.en: I have no regrets at all...
lines.zh: 我一点都不后悔……

lines.en: : It really doesn’t feel like 1:00 AM, does it?
lines.zh: : 真的一点都不像凌晨一点，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s technically not even our anniversary anymore.
lines.zh: : 是啊。严格来说，连纪念日都过了。

lines.en: scene himadinner31
: Well, whatever you do, don’t let Hima-chan hear you say that. Not after all the trouble she must have gone through to make this happen.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，千万别让 Hima 酱听见你这么说。她为了这一晚不知费了多少心思。

lines.en: : It’s kind of funny, though. A few weeks ago, she asked me to teach her how to make hamburg steak and I didn’t think anything of it. Just thought it was a craving.
lines.zh: : 不过也挺好笑的。几周前她让我教她做汉堡排，我当时没多想，只当她是嘴馋。

lines.en: : I should have ordered the frozen garlic bread instead and thrown her off her game. She’s become too powerful, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我当初该点那份冷冻蒜香面包的，好打乱她的节奏。她变得太强了，Ayane。

lines.en: scene himadinner32
: Right?! Like, how are we supposed to look at her and not want to just...squeeze her until she explodes?!
lines.zh: : 就是啊！？你说，看着她，怎么可能不想……把她抱紧到爆炸？！

lines.en: : There’s no way all parents feel this way, right? Like, this has gotta be an “us” thing.
lines.zh: : 天底下不可能所有父母都是这种感觉吧？这肯定是「我们家专属」的毛病。

lines.en: : I think we’re both living examples of how not all parents feel this way, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们俩本身就是活生生的例子，证明不是所有父母都这样，Ayane。

lines.en: scene himadinner33
: Well...true.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也是。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 可是……

lines.en: : But what? What’s with that solemn, contemplative look all of a sudden? Don’t let Himawari catch wind of that either or she’ll scold us for not having enough fun again.
lines.zh: : 可是什么？怎么突然一脸严肃在沉思？别让 Himawari 察觉到，不然她又要说我们玩得不尽兴了。

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: scene himadinner34
: Well, you’ve {i}”remembered”{/i} some stuff right? About all the time we missed when we woke up here?
lines.zh: : 嗯，你{i}「想起来」{/i}了一些事对吧？关于我们在这里醒来时错过的那些年月？

lines.en: : You mean, like...memories from stuff we weren’t exactly present for?
lines.zh: : 你是说……那些我们其实并不在场的记忆？

lines.en: : Exactly. How there will be, like...faint traces of things you just sort of {i}know,{/i} but can’t quite understand why or how.
lines.zh: : 对。就是那种……你隐约知道一些事，却说不清为什么、怎么{i}知道{/i}的。

lines.en: : Sure. Plenty of stuff that {i}I{/i} do for the first time here feels familiar. Is that what you mean?
lines.zh: : 嗯。{i}我{/i}在这儿第一次做的很多事都觉得很熟悉。你是这个意思吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. But, like...
lines.zh: : 对。不过……

lines.en: : Even with all of that. All of that stuff that I just {i}know{/i} now-
lines.zh: : 即便有了那些。即便有了那些我现在就是{i}知道{/i}的事——

lines.en: : I still don’t really know anything about {i}your{/i} parents.
lines.zh: : 我还是对{i}你的{/i}父母一无所知。

lines.en: : Which is fine. I don’t {i}need{/i} to. I just...figured you’d have mentioned something by now since we’ve been together for so long.
lines.zh: : 这没什么。我不{i}需要{/i}知道。只是……我们在一起这么久了，我以为你早就该提过点什么了。

lines.en: : Ahh. Yeah, it’d probably feel weird for me if I was forced into the same boat.
lines.zh: : 啊。是啊，如果换成我被这么问，大概也会觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: : Were they really that bad? That you’d just...block them out?
lines.zh: : 他们真的有那么糟吗？糟到你干脆……把他们屏蔽掉？

lines.en: : I don’t really know.
lines.zh: : 我真的不知道。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Like...{i}maybe?{/i} They’d kind of need to be for me to...{i}grow{/i} the way I did. Just the details are so sparing that it feels like thinking about them at all is a waste of time.
lines.zh: : 怎么说呢……{i}也许{/i}是吧？他们大概必须有那么糟，我才会……{i}长成{/i}这样。只是细节太少，少到我觉得去想他们根本是浪费时间。

lines.en: : That doesn’t always stop me, though. Like, just a little while ago, a stray thought about my mother found its way back to me.
lines.zh: : 不过这也不总能拦住我。比如就在不久前，一个关于我母亲的念头又自己找回来了。

lines.en: : What kind of thought? If you don’t mind telling me, of course.
lines.zh: : 什么样的念头？当然，如果你不介意告诉我的话。

lines.en: : Just that I’d be a bit of a disappointment now. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 只是觉得，现在的我大概会让她有点失望。就这样。

lines.en: scene himadinner35
: What? What’s {i}that{/i} look?
lines.zh: : 怎么？{i}那{/i}是什么表情？

lines.en: : A serious one. That doesn’t pretend to understand you, but wants you to know that {i}I{/i} don’t think you’re a disappointment.
lines.zh: : 一个严肃的表情。它没有假装理解你，只是想让你知道，{i}我{/i}不觉得你是让人失望的人。

lines.en: : I think you’re amazing. And handsome. And a better father and husband than either of us would have ever imagined.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你很了不起。也很帅。而且你是个比我们俩想象中都要好的父亲和丈夫。

lines.en: : I don’t know enough about your parents to hate them. And I don’t really know if {i}you{/i} hate them either. Just...
lines.zh: : 我对你的父母了解不多，还谈不上恨他们。我也不确定你{i}自己{/i}恨不恨他们。只是……

lines.en: : I’m also thankful. Because I’d still be incomplete if it wasn’t for them.
lines.zh: : 我也心怀感激。因为如果不是他们，我到现在都还是不完整的。

lines.en: : I’m thankful to your parents for the same reason.
lines.zh: : 我出于同样的理由，也感激你的父母。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} know enough to hate them, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我对他们了解得{i}够多{/i}，足够我去恨了。

lines.en: scene himadinner36
: Heh...At least we have Geoffrey, right?
lines.zh: : 呵呵……至少我们还有 Geoffrey，对吧？

lines.en: : Think he’s willing to adopt me this late into both of our lives?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他愿意在我们俩都走到这步的时候收养我吗？

lines.en: : It might interfere with our marriage license, but I’ll see what I can do.
lines.zh: : 那可能会影响我们的结婚证，不过我看看能怎么办吧。

lines.en: : Want to invite him over for Christmas? It’s been a while, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 想请他来过圣诞节吗？也有一阵子没见了，对吧？

lines.en: scene himadinner37
: You wouldn’t mind?
lines.zh: : 你不介意？

lines.en: : Not at all. He’s basically always been your actual father as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: : 完全不介意。在我看来，他基本上一向才是你真正的父亲。

lines.en: scene himadinner38
: Maybe I’ll give him a call then.
lines.zh: : 那我也许会给他打个电话。

lines.en: : Let’s table this for now, though. Dinner approaches.
lines.zh: : 不过这个话题先放一放吧。晚餐要来了。

lines.en: scene himadinner39
: Mr. and Mrs. Arakawa — apologies for the delay. Cooking with a hotplate on one’s computer desk is not as easy as it sounds.
lines.zh: : Arakawa 先生、Arakawa 太太——抱歉久等了。在电脑桌上用电磁炉做菜，并没有听起来那么容易。

lines.en: : Regardless, dinner is served. Will either of you be requiring another glass of Chateau Margaux?
lines.zh: : 总之，晚餐已备好。二位需要再来一杯 Chateau Margaux 吗？

lines.en: : I’m okay for now, Hima-chan. I’ve barely touched the first one.
lines.zh: : 我先不用了，Hima 酱。第一杯我都还没怎么喝。

lines.en: : You’re done cooking already? That felt quick.
lines.zh: : 你已经做完了？感觉好快。

lines.en: scene himadinner40
: Service is faster when the entire restaurant is reserved for two, Mr. Arakawa. There’s no way these dishes were made beforehand and merely heated up, if that’s what you’re suggesting.
lines.zh: : 当整个餐厅只为两位预留时，上菜自然就快，Arakawa 先生。如果您是在暗示这些菜是提前做好、只是热了一下，那是绝对不可能的。

lines.en: : ...Well, it {i}wasn’t.{/i} But now that you mention it-
lines.zh: : ……嗯，我本来{i}没那个意思{/i}。不过你这么一说——

lines.en: : Please hold that thought while I retrieve an even {i}stronger{/i} bottle of wine from the cellar. The Margaux doesn’t pair well with fish, you see.
lines.zh: : 请先把那个想法收一收，我去酒窖再拿一瓶{i}更烈{/i}的酒。您知道的，Margaux 跟鱼不太搭。

lines.en: : Before you go, there’s something else.
lines.zh: : 你先别走，还有件事。

lines.en: scene himadinner41
: Any other complaints can be submitted through our website. The manager is far too busy right now to-
lines.zh: : 其他任何投诉请通过我们的网站提交。经理现在实在太忙了，没空——

lines.en: : I just wanted to say thank you. For all of this.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说声谢谢。为了这一切。

lines.en: scene himadinner42
: Huh?
: Dinner. It’s an amazing gesture and an even better surprise.
lines.zh: : 这顿晚餐。这是个了不起的心意，更是个了不起的惊喜。

lines.en: : Thank you for making our lives better in every possible way.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，用一切可能的方式，让我们的生活变得更好。

lines.en: scene himadinner43
: Wha-
: We love you, Himawari. More than anything.
lines.zh: : 我们爱你，Himawari。胜过一切。

lines.en: scene himadinner44
: S...Stop embarrassing the wait staff! They have a job to do!
lines.zh: : 别……别再让服务人员难为情了！他们还有工作要做呢！

lines.en: scene black
Dinner is delicious, even {i}if{/i} it’s just reheated.
lines.zh: 晚餐很美味，{i}哪怕{/i}只是重新热过的。

lines.en: There’s a not-so-secret ingredient in every single bite.
lines.zh: 每一口里，都有一味不算秘密的配料。
